name: Lifestream's Blessing
oracle_text:
Draw X cards, where X is the greatest power among creatures you controlled as you cast this spell. If this spell was cast from exile, you gain twice X life.
Foretell {4}{G} (During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.)
blocked_sentences: Draw X cards, where X is the greatest power among creatures you controlled as you cast this spell. If this spell was cast from exile, you gain twice X life.

needs.what: a value read as the spell is cast and stamped on its stack object, so resolution can use it: here the greatest power among creatures its caster controlled at cast time (e.g. `{"as_cast": {"extreme_value": ...}}` or a cast-time `snapshot` binding readable from spell_effects)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `extreme_value`/`max` over a creature selector is evaluated at resolution, so a creature that dies or shrinks in response changes X; `snapshot` is an op that runs at resolution, and `power_of`/`power_had` read one object, not the board at cast time. Only `cast_during` and the `cast_from_*` stamps are recorded at cast, and none carries a number
